title: CGU, supported by ALICE, cuts R$2.38 million from a 2021 Hospital Federal de Ipanema glove tender and R$5.95 million from an undated INCA glove tender
summary: With ALICE support, CGU cut R$2.38m from a 2021 Ipanema hospital glove tender and R$5.95m from an INCA tender; R$8.33m avoided
account: A CGU statement of 4 October 2023 describes five preventive audits of tenders by federal hospitals and institutes in Rio de Janeiro. The automated tool ALICE supported them. The CGU says this prevented at least R$8.33 million of overpriced purchases. At the Instituto Nacional de Câncer (INCA), a glove auction estimated at R$11 million was re-estimated at R$5.1 million after ALICE indicated prices above market. That avoided about R$5.95 million. At the Hospital Federal de Ipanema, Pregão 15/2021 for gloves (estimated R$34 million) had reused the price survey of Pregão 05/2021. On CGU's recommendation it was suspended and re-estimated, cutting R$2,381,663.00. The auction held on 21 July 2021 bought every item at or below the new estimates, totaling R$14,315,793.42.
purpose: Preventive audit of federal procurement notices using automated risk alerts to stop overpriced purchases before award
system: ALICE (Analisador de Licitações, Contratos e Editais), CGU automated audit-trail and AI alert tool
developer: Controladoria-Geral da União (CGU), in-house (launched 2015 per the release)
domain: Public administration: government audit and procurement control
segment: Federal internal control of health-sector purchasing

ratings.reason: No identifiable individual beneficiary; patients benefit only indirectly through preserved hospital budgets.
Material to the hospitals and the federal budget: R$2,381,663.00 cut from one auction and about R$5.95 million from another. R$8.33 million avoided across the five audits per the CGU.
Small at national scale relative to federal purchasing of about R$119 billion a year.

ai_role.statement: The CGU states the audits were done “com apoio da ferramenta automatizada ALICE”. At INCA, it says, the overpricing risk was identified “com a ajuda do ALICE”. For the Ipanema tender, suspension followed a CGU recommendation after analysis of the price survey. ALICE's documented role is alerting and supporting the audit; auditors and managers decided. Developer and deployer are the same public body. The CGU page is on record as an archived copy, because the live page was restricted during Brazil's 2026 electoral period.

headline: CGU, with ALICE support, avoids R$8.33m in overpriced purchases
metric: prevented at least R$8.33 million of overpriced purchases

comparator.against: the original estimated value of Pregão 15/2021, which reused the price survey of Pregão 05/2021
comparator.after: reduziu o valor total do pregão em R$ 2.381.663,00; all items bought for R$ 14.315.793,42 on 21 July 2021
comparator.quote: Observou-se, no entanto, que foi utilizada a mesma pesquisa de preço do pregão de n. º 05/2021 e por recomendação da CGU, o certame foi suspenso e uma nova estimativa de preços foi realizada. A nova análise reduziu o valor total do pregão em R$ 2.381.663,00. Em 21 de julho de 2021, o pregão foi realizado e todos os itens foram adquiridos por valores unitários iguais ou inferiores aos estimados pela unidade, totalizando o montante de R$ 14.315.793,42.

later.note: By the end of 2024 the CGU reported 126 bodies registered to receive ALICE alerts, including 94 state, district and municipal units, and R$257.25 million saved in concluded 2024 audits.
later.quote: Em 2024, 126 entes foram cadastrados para recebimento de alertas do robô ALICE, sendo 32 órgãos federais, 33 unidades da esfera estadual e distrital e 61 unidades da esfera municipal. Para os próximos anos, A Controladoria-Geral da União tem a perspectiva de ampliar o uso do robô ALICE para mais gestores federais, estaduais e municipais.

value.what: overpriced hospital purchases avoided across five preventive audits
value.who: the federal government (hospitals and institutes in Rio de Janeiro)
value.quote: A Controladoria-Geral da União (CGU) realizou, preventivamente, cinco auditorias em editais de contratações de hospitais federais e institutos sediados no Rio de Janeiro/RJ. A ação evitou que, pelo menos, R$ 8,33 milhões fossem desperdiçados em aquisições de insumos e serviços hospitalares com sobrepreço.

Benefit type kept within Trustible's six types (Improved Organizational Efficiency); the sweep's proposed “Reduced Risk” is not in the taxonomy.

Benefit type set to Reduced Risk under Trustible's full taxonomy of 23 types; it was Improved Organizational Efficiency among the six first used.
Country of the developer and the deployer added from the organization's own site or a registry.
